finding: No test checks that scripts/crap-measure-typescript keeps the duty of its header: exit non-zero with a cause and no rows after a failed test run, for a file that no test loads, and when ESLint cannot start. CG-13-IT-02 runs only the case of a fully covered function. A change that writes rows after a failed test run, or that reports an unloaded file at 0 %, passes every test of the story. The review checked the paths by hand: without npx on PATH the command exits 1 with "ESLint cannot start: spawnSync npx ENOENT", and with an empty npm cache and npm_config_offline=true it exits 1 with "ENOTCACHED". In both cases it writes no rows. Fix: add three cases to tests/factory/test_crap_gate_repository.py: a failing test, a .ts file that no test imports, and a PATH without npx; each asserts a non-zero exit, the cause on stderr and no GATE_OUTPUT file.
why_this_severity: The code keeps the duty today, and no QA row of this repository's TypeScript command owns these cases (no to fails_purpose). A later change to the command can break the duty of BR-130 without a failing test.
